label: Oblivion Remastered sandboxes
description: How Oblivion Remastered sandboxes deploy, and how to find the game on this machine. Paths: mo2.

notes: This is a different game from the original Oblivion and does not read the original's Data folder the same way.
UE4SS script mods go in OblivionRemastered/Binaries/Win64/ue4ss/Mods and OBSE64 plugins have their own folder; neither is handled by this rule.
Saves are in Documents/My Games/Oblivion Remastered/Saved/SaveGames.
Hard links are the default: nothing is copied twice when two sandboxes share a mod, and every file is still a real file to the game.

presets.label: Clean
presets.description: Nothing deployed - the vanilla game, for checking whether a bug is yours.

options.label: Additional launch arguments
options.description: Passed verbatim. One argument per space; nothing here goes through a shell.
